name: echolyx-MVP
description: Echolyx AI is an industrial predictive-maintenance MVP that uses audio-based machine learning to detect developing fan faults before failure. It uses PANNs CNN14 transfer learning to classify fan recordings as Normal or Faulty, with a Gradio interface for audio upload/microphone inference.

paragraphs: This is the Echolyx AI proof of concept for its predictive-maintenance mission: listening to industrial equipment and catching developing faults before they become failures. The problem we're attacking is that unplanned machinery failure is expensive and hard to predict, while sound is an underused, low-cost signal that often reveals trouble (rattling, grinding, unbalance) early on — yet no simple tool lets a non-expert point a microphone at a machine and get an immediate "healthy vs. faulty" read (see PRD.md, sections 1–2, for the full background).
